title: has anyone been to a model train store?
content: I'm not sure of it's in the mall, but it has a similar aesthetic. Shelves that are set into the wall like shadow boxes, with various model setups. Shelves lined with train memorabilia, books, models, anything you could ask for. Bright white, everything is glaringly white and clean. I don't even really care about trains. But they show up a lot.
